purpose: Evidence-to-workflow mapping for lead integration into one master coverage register. Does not replace it or mark the audit complete.
scope: Registered E001-E146 captures, BRIEF question/summary captures and current registered D-R defaults. Later E-series captures are excluded until the next checkpoint.
method: Read each available saved .dom.txt or .txt snapshot and record actual landmark/control markers.

Never infer keyboard navigation, cancellation, saved changes or permission branches from a screenshot alone. Explicit interaction facts are labelled lead-recorded.
Incremental accessibility diffs may omit unchanged content; absence from such files is not proof of UI absence.
